title: Kirby - Nightmare in Dream Land
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 770 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Platformer. PC mGBA: new game reads 6/6 health (raw 48 = 6<<3); not yet seen changing. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A jump (again to float), B inhale / use ability, down+A slide, Select drop ability.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Swallow an enemy to copy its ability.
widgets.label: Copy

widgets.text: e.g. Beam, Fire, Ice, Cutter, Sword, Hammer, Spark, Stone, Parasol, Needle, Wheel, Laser, Tornado, Ball, Throw, Backdrop, Fireball, Crash, Mike, Sleep, Light...
widgets.label: Copy abilities

widgets.text: Inhale the stars bosses throw and spit them back. Hammer and Sword are strong boss abilities.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Vegetable Valley, Ice Cream Island, Butter Building, Grape Garden, Yogurt Yard, Orange Ocean, Rainbow Resort, then Fountain of Dreams.
widgets.label: Levels

widgets.text: Food restores health; Maxim Tomato restores all; 1-Up; Invincibility Candy.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Hidden switches open the Museum and Arena rooms; complete the switches for 100%.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Whispy Woods, Paint Roller, Mr. Shine & Mr. Bright, Kracko, Heavy Mole, Meta Knight, King Dedede, Nightmare.
widgets.label: Order
